claim: La Rei Natura is the gastronomic restaurant inside Il Boscareto Resort & Spa, led by Michelangelo Mammoliti.
quote: Michelangelo Mammoliti and his brigade are waiting for you from March 27th

claim: La Rei Natura earned its third Michelin star in the 2026 Italian guide, ~26 months after opening.
quote: Michelangelo Mammoliti earns third Michelin star for La Rei Natura just two years after opening

claim: La Rei Natura is the sole new Italian three-star in the 2026 Michelin guide, bringing Italy's three-star count to 15.
quote: With 15 three Michelin stars, thanks to the new entry La Rei Natura by Michelangelo Mammoliti in the Boscareto Resort in Serralunga d'Alba

claim: Il Boscareto Resort & Spa has 49 rooms and suites, an indoor pool, La Sovrana Spa, 62-space covered parking with EV charging, and is at Via Roddino 21.
quote: Via Roddino, 21 – 12050 Serralunga D'Alba (Cn) Italy ... 49 rooms and suites

claim: Il Boscareto Resort is roughly a 25-minute walk from the Castle of Serralunga d'Alba and a 5-minute drive.
quote: located nearly a 25-minute walk from Castle of Serralunga d'Alba ... within a 5-minute drive of Castle of Serralunga d'Alba

claim: Boscareto is at Strada Roddino 21, in the Ornato area of Serralunga d'Alba, 1.2 miles (≈1.9 km) from the centre.
quote: Strada Roddino, 21, 1.2 miles from the centre of Serralunga d'Alba

claim: Standard rooms at Boscareto run roughly $524–$870 / night based on average rates, with an underground EV-equipped car park and full daily breakfast.
quote: $524 - $870 (Based on Average Rates for a Standard Room) ... Underground car park, large, accessible by elevator

claim: Top-ranked lodging in Serralunga d'Alba on TripAdvisor: Boscareto (4.4), Villaggio Narrante–Le Case dei Conti Mirafiore (4.3), Garesio (5.0), Cà 'd Calin (5.0), Tota Virginia (4.5), I Grappoli (4.9), Cascina Meriame (4.9), Albergo del Castello (3.8), La Rosa dei Vini (4.2).
quote: Il Boscareto Resort & SPA ... Villaggio Narrante Le Case dei Conti Mirafiore ... Garesio Wine Resort ... Cà 'd Calin Casa nel Borgo ... Antico Podere Tota Virginia ... Agriturismo I Grappoli ... Agriturismo Cascina Meriame ... Albergo Ristorante Trattoria Del Castello ... La Rosa dei Vini

claim: Cà 'd Calin Casa nel Borgo sits on Piazza Umberto I in the historic centre, beneath the castle, at $173–$232/night, perfect 5.0 rating.
quote: 3 Piazza Umberto I, 12050 Serralunga d'Alba ... right beneath a historical castle ... $173 - $232 (Based on Average Rates for a Standard Room)

claim: Casa Cucco is a 2-bedroom apartment above the San Sebastiano church in the historic village, sleeps 4, with a Langhe-hills terrace.
quote: located just above the small church of San Sebastiano nel Borgo by the town entry ... 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom ... terrace with city views

claim: Antico Podere Tota Virginia is a converted farmhouse at Località Baudana 69 with pool and on-site restaurant, ~2 km from Serralunga centre, 5-min drive.
quote: Località Baudana 69, 12050, Serralunga d'Alba ... two kilometres away from Serralunga d'Alba ... swimming pool and panoramic terrace

claim: Agriturismo I Grappoli sits at Borgata Parafada 5, 1.4 km from the castle and 1.2 km from Tenuta Cucco.
quote: Borgata Parafada 5, 12050, Serralunga d'Alba ... Tenuta Cucco is 1.2 km away, Castle of Serralunga d'Alba is 1.4 km away

claim: Cascina Meriame is a five-room agriturismo with infinity pool, on its own Meriame cru vineyards, ~1.1 km (0.7 mi) from Serralunga centre.
quote: Località Meriame, 1, 12050 Serralunga d'Alba ... 0.7 miles away from the center of Serralunga d'Alba ... beautiful infinity pool facing the Langa hills

claim: Albergo Ristorante Trattoria Del Castello is a 7-room 3-star with restaurant at Loc. Baudana 16, about 1.9 km from the centre.
quote: Loc. Baudana, 16, 12050 Serralunga d'Alba ... 1.9 km from the city center ... 7 rooms

claim: Garesio Wine Resort is a modern country guesthouse with cellar, pool and wellness centre at Località Sordo, where the Cerretta and Gianetto crus meet.
quote: Localita Sordo 1, Serralunga d'Alba ... wine cellar, swimming pool and wellness centre ... where the famous cru Cerretta meets cru Gianetto

claim: La Rosa dei Vini is a small family hotel-restaurant with six rooms on a vineyard hill at Località Parafada 4.
quote: Località Parafada n.4, 12050 Serralunga d'Alba ... three double rooms and three rooms with three (expandable to four) beds

claim: Villaggio Narrante at Fontanafredda groups three properties — Cascina Galarej, Le Case dei Conti Mirafiore, Foresteria delle Vigne — inside the Fontanafredda estate with on-site restaurants (Disguido, Guido).
quote: Cascina Galarej boutique hotel ... Le Case dei Conti Mirafiore, a historic building ... 14 elegant rooms ... Foresteria delle Vigne offers 11 cosy rooms

claim: Le Case dei Conti Mirafiore is at Via Alba 15, inside the Fontanafredda historic village.
quote: Via Alba, 15 Serralunga d'Alba (CN) 12050 - Italia ... within the historic Villaggio Narrante di Fontanafredda

claim: Foresteria delle Vigne rooms start around $287/night.
quote: Villaggio Narrante - Foresteria Delle Vigne in Serralunga d'Alba, Italy from 287$

claim: Michelin Italy 2026 names La Rei Natura by Michelangelo Mammoliti among the new three-star promotions.
quote: The New Stars of The MICHELIN Guide Italy 2026

claim: The Castle of Serralunga d'Alba sits at the top of the historic medieval village, the anchor of the old town.
quote: Castle of Serralunga d'Alba

claim: Serralunga d'Alba's historic centre is built on a steep cobblestone radial layout of narrow streets.
quote: the narrow streets of Serralunga d'Alba are almost all cobblestone, arranged in a radial pattern

claim: Boscareto offers a paid shuttle to and from the nearest train station.
quote: Shuttle service is available to local airports upon request ... shuttle service to and from the train station (fees apply)

claim: Cà 'd Calin is a B&B/guesthouse in the medieval village foot of Serralunga castle, about 10 minutes from Alba.
quote: in the heart of the Langhe region, at the foot of Serralunga Castle, about 10 minutes from Alba
